spec:
I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  clk
 - input  a
 - output q (3 bits)

The module implements a sequential circuit. Read the simulation waveforms
to determine what the circuit does, then implement it.

  time  clk a   q
  0ns   0   1   x
  5ns   1   1   4
  10ns  0   1   4
  15ns  1   1   4
  20ns  0   1   4
  25ns  1   1   4
  30ns  0   1   4
  35ns  1   1   4
  40ns  0   1   4
  45ns  1   0   4
  50ns  0   0   4
  55ns  1   0   5
  60ns  0   0   5
  65ns  1   0   6
  70ns  0   0   6
  75ns  1   0   0
  80ns  0   0   0
  85ns  1   0   1
  90ns  0   0   1
final_design:
module TopModule (
    input  logic       clk,
    input  logic       a,
    output logic [2:0] q
);

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (a) begin
            q <= 3'd4;
        end else begin
            if (q == 3'd6) begin
                q <= 3'd0;
            end else begin
                q <= q + 3'd1;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
